answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Reaching the opal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a measured tone, citations in parentheses register, it stays short. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Each submission hangs on the zenith of a task receipt, and the knoll is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
